descriptor: Evaluate whether leaders create clear boundaries, enable team autonomy, remove systemic constraints, and learn from outcomes.
raw: Agile Leadership & Management Evaluate whether leaders create clear boundaries, enable team autonomy, remove systemic constraints, and learn from outcomes.

entries.descriptor: Leaders prioritize command-and-control practices and discourage autonomy.
Leaders are not actively involved in agile practices and rarely attend team ceremonies.
Leaders verbally support agile but continue to reward traditional metrics like utilization.
Managers make most key decisions, with limited team input.
Leaders empower teams to self-organize and make decisions within their domain.
Leadership encourages experimentation and tolerates failure as part of learning.
Goals, performance systems, and incentives reward customer outcomes, collaboration, learning, and sustainable delivery.
Leaders remove systemic constraints, clarify decision boundaries, and build team capability.
Leaders actively coach others on agile principles and foster cross-team collaboration.
Leaders use feedback, reflection, and observed outcomes to improve how they enable the organization.
